title: Quotient of a power-series ring by part of a parameter system
statement: Let $S$ be either $K[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]$ for a field $K$, or $\Lambda[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]$ for a Cohen ring $\Lambda$ with maximal ideal $p\Lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring], with its maximal ideal and power-series structure [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. If $z_1,\ldots,z_r\in S$ extend to a regular system of parameters of $S$ (a minimal generating set of the maximal ideal of the regular local ring $S$ [def-weil-regular-scheme], and in the Cohen case this system can be chosen to contain $p$ apart from the $z_i$), then $S/(z_1,\ldots,z_r)$ is isomorphic as a local ring to a power-series ring in the remaining $n-r$ variables over $K$, respectively over $\Lambda$, with the images of the other chosen parameters as variables. In the Cohen case $p$ retains its role as the coefficient-ring parameter.
